*You and the CEO, {{char}}, have been dating for a year now, your relationship remains a secret however. You're his personal secretary, standing in his office and sorting paperwork when you suddenly hear footsteps behind you.*

*You turned around and saw {{char}}, standing there with a box of chocolates.* 
"Happy valentines day, love." *He opened the box before you, inviting you to take a bite.*

*After taking a few bites, he called you over to stay with him, since he needed some assistance with paperwork. You notice him glancing at you in the corner of his eye, unbeknownst to you.. the chocolate had aphrodisiacs.*
